title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 080
review_goal: Differentiate rocket and rows variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Rocket body viewed from the side with one round window one nose cone and fins spread around the lower body
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a fuller side view rocket body with a visible window and lower fins.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the steeper launch rocket when the whole body should lean sharply toward the upper right.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a broad side view rocket with the window and fins distributed around the main body.

items.depicts_observation: Rocket body angled sharply toward the upper right with a long pointed nose and trailing lower fins
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a rocket posed like an upward launch rather than a flatter side profile.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the broader side view rocket when the body should sit more horizontally with a fuller rear section.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot tilts the rocket into a stronger upward launch angle than the first variant.

items.depicts_observation: One outer frame split into two stacked horizontal rows by one middle divider line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants two stacked rows contained inside one shared outer frame.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the separate row cards when the two rows should sit apart with a visible gap between them.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps both rows inside one continuous border with a divider through the middle.

items.depicts_observation: Two separate horizontal panels stacked with one open gap between them
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants two stacked row panels that stay visually separate from each other.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the shared frame rows when both rows should live inside one combined outer border.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot breaks the rows into two distinct cards instead of one frame with an internal divider.

items.depicts_observation: One outer frame split into three stacked horizontal rows with two divider lines
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants three stacked rows inside one shared frame instead of two.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the two row variants when the layout should stop at two stacked sections.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a third horizontal section within the same outer border.
